scripts.start: concurrently -k -s all --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" -n "server,client,ai" "node backend/dev.js" "node frontend/dev.js" "npm run ai"
scripts.ai: if [ -f .venv/bin/python3 ]; then (cd backend/services/ai_summary && ../../../.venv/bin/python3 run.py); elif [ -f backend/services/ai_summary/venv/bin/python3 ]; then (cd backend/services/ai_summary && ./venv/bin/python3 run.py); else (cd backend/services/ai_summary && python3 run.py); fi
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
